**Use this template only to choose the correct route. Do not paste evidence here.**

Psyche Build keeps vulnerable details, credentials, and private data out of public issues. Route your report:

- **Reproducible bug on a supported surface** → [Bug report form](https://github.com/OpenCoven/psyche-build/issues/new?template=bug.yml)
- **Product or workflow proposal** → [Feature request form](https://github.com/OpenCoven/psyche-build/issues/new?template=feature.yml)
- **Incorrect, missing, or stale documentation** → [Documentation report form](https://github.com/OpenCoven/psyche-build/issues/new?template=documentation.yml)
- **Suspected security vulnerability** → [Private vulnerability report](https://github.com/OpenCoven/psyche-build/security/advisories/new) — never a public issue
- **Usage questions and support** → [SUPPORT.md](https://github.com/OpenCoven/psyche-build/blob/main/SUPPORT.md)
- **Contribution questions** → [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/OpenCoven/psyche-build/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)

If you came here to report a security problem, stop and use the private flow above. If your report does not fit any form, describe in one or two sentences what you need and nothing more — do not include credentials, tokens, private keys, raw prompts, unrestricted terminal output, private repository contents, private service URLs, unredacted personal paths, or vulnerability details. See [SUPPORT.md](https://github.com/OpenCoven/psyche-build/blob/main/SUPPORT.md) for the redaction rules that apply to everything you publish on this tracker.
